settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: App-level preferences, stored locally on this machine — not workflow or Configure data.
settings.loadError: Couldn't load some settings -- the app may need a restart.

general.launchAtLoginCaption: Starts Mill automatically when you log in.
general.launchAtLoginRequiresApproval: Confirm in System Settings to finish turning this on.
general.errorDevBinary: Not available in this dev build -- only a built .app bundle can be a login item.
general.errorServerMode: Not available in server mode -- there is no login-item concept without a desktop app to register.

keyboardShortcuts.description: Every in-window command Mill dispatches. Rebind one by clicking its combo and pressing a new one — the same recorder used for a workflow's own trigger hotkey below.

globalHotkey.description: Opens Mill's Quick Panel from anywhere, even when Mill is in the background — search and run a workflow, or jump into Mill itself. Press again to dismiss it. Distinct from a workflow's own trigger hotkey, set per-workflow on its canvas.
globalHotkey.reservedError: {{combo}} is reserved by macOS ({{reason}}) — pick another combo

mcp.addressCaption: Where MCP clients connect to Mill. Loopback (127.0.0.1) reaches this Mac only; a non-loopback address also accepts other devices on your network. Saved changes apply after you restart Mill.
mcp.addressSaved: Saved. Restart Mill to use the new address.
mcp.addressEnvOverrideCaption: The MILL_MCP_ADDR environment variable sets this address, overriding anything saved here.
mcp.allowImportLabel: Allow MCP clients to import data
mcp.allowImportCaption: When on, MCP clients connected to Mill can create workflows, integrations, lists, and MCP-server entries via the import tools. Reading and exporting are always allowed and never include secrets. Off by default; changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
mcp.askBeforeImportLabel: Ask me before each MCP import
mcp.askBeforeImportCaption: Each import parks until you approve it in Mill, or times out after 2 minutes and is denied. Turning this off lets an enabled MCP client import without a per-write approval. On by default.

remoteAccess.description: Mill is reachable from any device on your network. Pairing is what keeps it yours.
remoteAccess.macAlwaysAllowed: This Mac always has access. Other devices pair once, then stay connected until you revoke them.
remoteAccess.codeExpiry: Enter this code on the other device within 5 minutes.
remoteAccess.emptyDescription: Pair a device to reach Mill from your phone or another computer.
remoteAccess.revokeConfirmBody: {{label}} won't be able to reach Mill until it's paired again.

notify.caption: Alerts you here when a decision needs your action and this tab isn't in view.
notify.granted: Notifications are on for this device.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked for this device. Turn them on again in your browser's site settings.
notify.unsupported: Notifications aren't available over this connection. It needs to be secure (https).

phone.caption: Install the ntfy Android app, then add this address as a subscription to get notified there, even when Mill isn't open.
phone.secretNote: Keep this address private — anyone who has it can read your notifications.

contract.description: The full step catalog, every data schema, and this app's version in one file — hand it to an agent that can't reach Mill directly.
contract.exportError: Couldn't export the contract — try again.
contract.exportSkillDescription: How to work with Mill — which tool fits which job, how approvals behave — for an agent that can't read mill://skill directly.
contract.exportSkillError: Couldn't export the skill doc — try again.

notifications.description: A parked guardrail ask or MCP write notifies you with a floating approval prompt once you're away — idle past the threshold below, or your window loses focus entirely. An actively-used Mill window is never notified twice.
notifications.awayAfterCaption: How long the Mac sits idle (no keyboard, mouse, or trackpad input) while Mill is focused before you're treated as away. Defaults to 300 seconds (5 minutes). Losing focus entirely always counts as away, regardless of this setting.
notifications.alertPermissionNote: To alert instead of appearing quietly in Notification Center, allow it in System Settings → Notifications → Mill → Alerts. Mill requests notification permission on first launch, but macOS still defaults new apps to Banners, which auto-dismiss.

updates.resignNotice: Mill re-signs itself after updating, so permission grants like Accessibility keep working.
updates.resignSetupNotice: Trust Mill's signing certificate once to keep permissions working across updates.
updates.trustSigningSucceeded: Trusted. Future updates won't need this again.
updates.sourceUpdateHint: This copy was built from source. Pull the latest code and rebuild to update.
updates.channelSaved: Saved. Restart Mill to start using this channel.
updates.installFallbackHint: Get the update with your browser instead — some networks block app downloads.
updates.proxyCaption: Update checks and downloads use this connection.
updates.proxySaved: Saved. Restart Mill to start using this proxy.
updates.proxyModeAuto: Auto — use this Mac's proxy settings
updates.autoCheckLabel: Check for and download updates automatically
updates.autoCheckCaption: Downloads updates in the background at the interval below, starting now.

dataStewardship.description: Mill snapshots your workflow history and settings automatically, and can bundle everything into one file to move to another machine.
dataStewardship.unavailable: Backups aren't available -- this instance uses a custom execution database.
dataStewardship.syncedFolderWarning: Keep backups in a synced folder. Keep the live data folder out of one.
dataStewardship.importConfirmEmpty: This file has nothing new to import.
dataStewardship.mirrorFilesNote: The export covers Mill's own data. Files mirrored from folders on disk are referenced by path, not copied in — back those folders up separately.

placeholderView.subtitle: This part of Mill hasn't been built yet.
placeholderView.specSectionNote: Not available in the UI yet.

mostUsed.noRunsInRange: No workflow runs yet in this range.
mostUsed.runOrTriggerHint: Run or trigger a workflow to see it here.
mostUsed.neverTriggeredLabel: hasn't run automatically in this range

home.heading: Home
home.subtitle: Time saved, what ran, and what to learn from it, all from local run history that never leaves this machine.
home.noRunsBlankslateHeading: No runs yet in this range
home.noRunsBlankslateDescription: Run or trigger a workflow and come back — Home fills in as soon as something runs.
home.volumeErrorDescription: Daily, in your local timezone. Error rate only shows once a day has at least 3 finished runs, so one failure can't misleadingly read as 100%.
home.mostUsedDescription: Every run counts here, however it fired. Editing a workflow's minutes-saved estimate feeds the Time saved figure above.
home.noAmbientRuns: No ambient (triggered) runs yet in this range — a manual test run doesn't count as automation replacing your own work.
home.noFinishedRuns: No finished runs yet in this range.
home.errorRateVolume: {{errorCount}} of {{total}} finished runs failed. A retry that eventually succeeded doesn’t count as a failure, and parked or cancelled runs are excluded.
home.noTimedRuns: No finished runs yet in this range.
home.noRunsInRangeShort: No runs yet in this range.
home.ambientBreakdown: {{triggered}} ran on their own (hotkey, schedule, watch) · {{manual}} you ran by hand.

activityRunsExplorer.noRecordedRunsDescription: Run this workflow to see its history here.
activityRunsExplorer.noRecordedRunsAllDescription: Run any workflow and every run — including failures — shows up here.

activityView.heading: Activity
activityView.subtitle: Every recorded run across your workflows — started by you or fired automatically, successes and failures alike.
activityView.sessionEventsDescription: Hotkey fires and agent write attempts from this session. Clears when Mill restarts.
activityView.searchPlaceholder: Search what ran or its result…

stepFailures.heading: Failures by step type
stepFailures.description: Which kind of step fails most often, across recent runs of every workflow.
stepFailures.noFailuresDescription: Failures will show up here, grouped by step type, once a run fails.

mcpCalls.heading: MCP calls
mcpCalls.description: Every call Mill's MCP server received, and every call Mill made to a configured MCP server.
mcpCalls.noCallsDescription: Calls will show up here once an agent calls Mill, or a workflow calls a configured MCP server.

reviewView.heading: Review
reviewView.subtitle: Everything waiting for a human — guardrail approvals, review checkpoints, and MCP write requests — approve to proceed, deny to stop it.
reviewView.nothingWaitingDescription: Approvals land here when a workflow needs your review — a guardrail ask, a review checkpoint, or an MCP write request.

guardrailRulesPanel.emptyDescription: Each step's defaults decide: external steps ask before running, everything else runs.

guardrailRuleDialog.conditionCaption: An expression over the step's payload, attributes, and config. Leave empty to always apply.
